layers.name: engine
layers.purpose: headless analysis: Node, type-stripped, no build step, no DOM. May reach into renderer only to test layout logic without a browser

layers.name: shell
layers.purpose: Electron main and preload, CommonJS. Shells out to the engine CLI rather than importing it, so Electron's bundled Node never has to strip types

layers.name: renderer
layers.purpose: Chromium: React, three.js, bundled by Vite. Reaches the shell only through the preload bridge
